hosting.processingLocations: Website files are stored in Germany and Sweden. Bunny.net delivers the site worldwide, including from locations outside the European Economic Area (EEA). Bunny says it processes and stores its request logs in the EU.
hosting.processorAgreement: Bunny.net acts as a processor under an accepted Data Processing Agreement covering confidentiality, security and subprocessors.
hosting.subprocessorInformation: Bunny.net publishes its current subprocessors at https://bunny.net/gdpr/sub-processors/.
hosting.transferSafeguards: Bunny says it handles requests at its global locations itself and that its network partners cannot read the customer data processed there. Bunny’s data processing agreement and safeguards for its service providers apply.
hosting.deliveryLegalBasis: We have a legitimate interest in delivering and securing the website and preventing abuse (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)).
hosting.deliveryInterests: Reliably serving requested pages and protecting the website against technical failures, attacks and misuse.
hosting.accessLogData: Request data can include your IP address, the requested page, browser details and the site you came from. Bunny can process full IP addresses even when it masks them in logs available to us.
hosting.accessLogAccessControls: The website operator and authorized Bunny.net personnel may access relevant logs to operate and protect the service.
hosting.backupRetentionPolicy: Bunny.net does not routinely back up website content or CDN logs. Exceptional temporary copies are deleted when the relevant recovery or migration operation and its verification are complete. No fixed maximum period is specified.

contact.providerInformation: Google Workspace handles our email, including information needed to deliver messages.
contact.legalBasis: Our legitimate interest is to answer enquiries and manage correspondence (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)). We also process requests when the law requires it, for example to exercise your data protection rights (Article 6(1)(c)).
contact.retentionCriteria: Support correspondence is deleted manually within 12 months after the matter is resolved, unless a legal obligation or the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims requires longer retention.
contact.transferSafeguards: Google and its service providers may process correspondence outside the EEA. Google’s data processing addendum provides for applicable adequacy decisions, EU Standard Contractual Clauses or other recognised safeguards.

analytics.hostingProvider: The website uses a self-hosted Matomo analytics service on infrastructure provided by OVHcloud.
analytics.processingLocations: Matomo’s main database is hosted in Warsaw, Poland.
analytics.processorAgreement: OVHcloud provides the infrastructure under an accepted Data Processing Agreement. The website operator runs the Matomo service.
analytics.subprocessorInformation: No analytics data is forwarded to other analytics services. OVHcloud may use service-related subprocessors under its contractual terms.
analytics.transferSafeguards: Where OVHcloud or its service providers process data outside the EEA, OVHcloud applies the safeguards in its data processing agreement, including EU Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable.
analytics.proxyLogData: Limited technical and error logs may be retained to maintain the security and reliability of the analytics service and investigate problems. Depending on the error, these logs may contain diagnostic request information.
analytics.accessControls: Only the website operator has access to the analytics interface and its data. OVHcloud provides the underlying infrastructure.
analytics.serverSettingsEvidence: 2026-11-14: The operator confirmed Matomo 5.14.2, two-byte IP masking, masked-IP geolocation, 90-day visit retention, 24-month report retention, scheduled deletion and disabled intrusive features. Poland hosting, restricted technical logging and 30-day log and backup retention were confirmed. Additional provider backups were disabled. These settings confirmations are separate from live-site behavior checks.
analytics.trackerResponseCookiePolicy: 2026-11-14: The operator reported no additional tracking-response cookies on other websites. Battery Monitor response-cookie behavior remains unverified; the 2026-11-19 tracking observations did not verify response cookies.
analytics.retentionEvidence: 2026-11-14: The operator confirmed automatic deletion of visit records after 90 days and reports after 24 months, with scheduled deletion operational and no basic metrics kept beyond that period. Technical logs and separate analytics backups have 30-day retention. Additional provider backups were disabled.
analytics.consentEvidenceProcedure: The browser stores the decision, notice version, decision time and expiry locally. If configured, the first page view after new consent records the notice version. Refusals are not tracked. This is not a complete server-side history of consent choices.

review.assessmentRecord: 2026-11-18: Last factual owner review by Tomasz Świstak, incorporating the 2026-11-14 provider and analytics assessment and the 2026-11-17 Google agreement confirmation. The review covered Bunny global CDN processing and EU storage, self-hosted Matomo in Warsaw, Google Workspace email, and the access and retention arrangements recorded above. 2026-11-20: Editorial simplification of the policy and configuration; no new owner review or operational verification is claimed. The 2026-11-19 tracking observations did not establish Battery Monitor response-cookie behavior, which remains unverified. This record is not a formal legal certification.
